scope: Named write destinations and bit fields, including qualified indexed owners, reset/cleanup writes and read-modify-writes. No raw byte values. No claim of all runtime writes.
limitations: Inherited indexed writer footprints retain the OEM caller/state assumptions and are not new runtime proofs.
Arbitrary factory upload, external hooks and runtime pointers have no invented fixed destination. Stack frames are not named absolute variables.
Reset writes to ASIC status windows do not establish physical write behavior or an inactive output.
Named word starts represent the full word; independently named byte/bit owners remain separate.
Unknown register identities remain explicit. Blank current use means retained write role, not byte-identical calibration or identical writer set.
Omitted describes the removed write role. Initialization, refresh or safe-off writes may remain and are identified separately.

The 2026-11-07 audit completes fixed-writer associations for named row starts. Separate full write-site inventory includes unnamed operands; this does not resolve inherited indexed/reset scopes or prove bit-level operational liveness.
